audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Lillia Levels 1, 2, 4-5 and 6 while every 'why' beside those rows says the opposite ('Level 1 you out-stat a squishy Lillia', 'Level 3 your Q silence hard-counters her', 'Level 6 is even'). The packet chart reads Garen / Garen / Garen / Garen / Skill / Lillia / Lillia.
audit.why: Garen wins 52.98% over 2148 games off exactly that shape — he owns the first four levels and loses the item stages. The side tokens were inverted against both the data and the prose.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the whole chart to the packet as one atomic group: content win[0..5] and full phases[0..6].side/rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff TRICKY at 7/10 difficulty for a matchup Garen wins, and report[5].t gives no rank scaling for Blooming Blows.
audit.why: A 52.98% lane is not 7/10 hard. And Blooming Blows goes 6s to 4s as she ranks it, so the punish window she gives you shrinks through the laning phase — that is the timing the player needs.
audit.corrected: Set diff EVEN / 5.5-10 with the two summary strings, and rewrote report[5].t with 6s→4s plus the true-damage edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields describe Lillia dashing in — 'her dash-in trades', 'the instant she dashes', 'Q dashes', 'the moment Lillia dashes in for a Q'.
audit.why: Lillia has no dash anywhere in her kit. Blooming Blows is an activated burst around herself that stacks move speed; her mobility is speed, not a gap-closer. That inverts the whole lane: she must walk into Garen's 300-range Decisive Strike, and once silenced she can only run, not blink. Also unstated: Blooming Blows' outer edge deals true damage, so stacking armour does not answer her, and Swirlseed's slow is purged outright by Decisive Strike.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0].text, whys[2], wants.you[0], wants.foe[2] and dontsFull[2].d.
